article.title: Why AI Systems Need an Abstain Option
article.author: OpenAI learning editor
article.why: 理解 AI 為什麼必須學會在證據、權限或信心不足時拒答、延後或升級給人。

paragraphs.en:
AI systems are often evaluated by asking whether they can produce an answer. In many applications, however, a more important question is whether the system knows when it should not answer. An abstain option allows a model or agent to refuse, defer, or escalate when evidence is weak, permissions are insufficient, or the requested action is outside its safe operating boundary.

Consider a customer-service assistant that can check an order status. If it finds a clear record, answering is straightforward. But suppose two customer records have similar names and the identifier is missing. Guessing may expose private information or create a wrong instruction. A safer system should say that it cannot confidently identify the account and ask for additional verification.

Abstention is also useful when evidence is incomplete. A retrieval-augmented system may receive documents that do not contain the information needed to answer a question. If the model is optimized only for answer completion, it may fill the gap with a plausible statement. Evaluation should therefore include cases where the correct behavior is “insufficient evidence,” not only cases with a known factual answer.

Permission boundaries create another category. An agent might know how to update a payment address but lack authorization to do so for a particular account. The right outcome is not a technically correct tool call. It is a refusal or escalation. This distinction separates capability from permission.

Designing abstention requires trade-offs. If the system refuses too often, users lose time and stop trusting it. If it refuses too rarely, error rates can become unacceptable. Teams can tune confidence thresholds, require stronger evidence for high-impact actions, and use different policies for low-risk and high-risk tasks. A recommendation about meeting times can tolerate more uncertainty than a decision involving money or sensitive data.

Evaluation metrics should reflect this structure. Accuracy on answered cases is useful, but it should be paired with coverage: the share of cases the system chooses to answer. Teams can also measure the error rate among accepted cases and the quality of escalations. A system that answers 100 percent of questions with many errors may be worse than one that answers 85 percent reliably and sends the remaining cases to a human.

An abstain option is not a weakness. It is a control mechanism. Human professionals also recognize situations where more information, permission, or expertise is required. AI systems that can represent uncertainty and stop at the right moment are often easier to govern than systems designed to appear confident at all times.

The system also needs a clear path after abstention. A refusal that simply says “I cannot help” may be safe but not useful. Better designs tell the user what information is missing, what verification is required, or which human team can continue the case. This makes abstention part of the workflow rather than a dead end.

Teams should test false abstentions as well as unsafe answers. If a model repeatedly escalates easy cases, operational cost rises and human reviewers become overloaded. Reviewers may then rush through escalations, creating a new source of risk. The goal is selective automation: automate cases that are sufficiently clear and route ambiguous cases to the right fallback.

Abstention policies should also be observable. Logs should record why a case was refused, which threshold or rule was triggered, and what happened after escalation. These data help teams distinguish weak retrieval, model uncertainty, missing permissions, or poor policy design. Over time, the organization can improve both the automated path and the human fallback.
paragraphs.zh: AI 系統不只要測『能不能回答』，也要測『什麼時候不該回答』。Abstain option 讓模型在證據不足、權限不足或超出安全邊界時拒答、延後或升級。例如客服 Agent 無法確定客戶身分時，猜測可能洩漏隱私；RAG 沒取到必要證據時，最正確行為可能是說明 evidence insufficient；Agent 即使知道如何改付款地址，若沒有授權也不該執行。設計 abstention 需要平衡 coverage 與 error：拒答太多會拖慢流程，拒答太少會增加事故。評估時可同時看 answered-case accuracy、coverage、accepted-case error rate 與 escalation quality。拒答後還應告訴使用者缺什麼資訊、需要什麼驗證或該轉給誰，避免變成 dead end。還要測 false abstention，否則人工 reviewer 可能被大量簡單案件淹沒。Logging 應記錄拒答原因、觸發 threshold 與 escalation 結果，讓團隊持續改善。
paragraphs.ja: AIは『答えられるか』だけでなく『答えるべきでない時を判断できるか』も評価する必要があります。Abstain optionにより、evidence不足、permission不足、安全範囲外のときに拒否・保留・escalationできます。顧客識別が曖昧な場合に推測するとprivacy riskが生じ、RAGで必要根拠がない場合は“insufficient evidence”が正解になることがあります。Agentが操作方法を知っていてもauthorizationがなければ実行すべきではありません。設計ではcoverageとerrorのtrade-offを調整し、answered-case accuracyだけでなくcoverage、accepted-case error、escalation qualityも測ります。拒否後には不足情報や必要なverification、担当チームを示し、dead endにしないことも重要です。False abstentionも評価し、loggingで拒否理由やthreshold、escalation結果を追跡します。
